title: Bills and pay due before setup that had not gone out or come in (decision X3, F20)
story: Set up Tue 22 Jun 2027 at 09:00. The bank holds 200,000, of which 30,000 is what is left of Free to spend (typed). The phone bill of 8,000 was due Mon 21 Jun and has not gone out yet; a side job's 500.00 dollars was due Tue 22 Jun into the yen bank and has not come in. Setup asks about each; both are saved in `not_yet`. Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier) starts the period; rent of 80,000 on the 27th (moved later). On Thu 24 Jun at 20:00 the person reads the bank statement: the phone bill's line, dated Tue 22 Jun (the setup day). Every amount is made up.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 200,000 (Bank today) - 8,000 (Phone 21 Jun, late: not gone out at setup, still inside its posting window) = 192,000
asks.note: Before X3 the phone bill was taken as inside the opening: 200,000.

asks.question: check_in_list
asks.why: 8,000 (the phone bill of Mon 21 Jun, not gone out at setup) = 8,000
asks.note: The side job's dollars are listed apart, in their own currency, outside the total [S6].

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 200,000 (opening, Tue 22 Jun 09:00) - 8,000 (the phone bill's statement line, dated the setup day; setup was told it had not gone out, so it is after the opening) = 192,000

asks.question: not_seen_yet
asks.note: The phone bill is settled by its statement line. The side job's dollars are past their posting window: listed in their own currency, out of the totals [S6].
